description: Band lift v2 (params/benchy upsidedown tilted.json) plus a local pit-free tilt field (CHANGELOG 2026-10-14, lip rotation): within 8 mm of the pits over the bulwark lips the rotation field is changed (adjoint of the pit depth, outside held) until the lips print from the deck without lifting; the band lift then lifts 0 vertices. Use with --params. The rim strip's terraces are gone, but a patch of closed rings appears on the hull side 3-8 mm above the rim; hull layer_turns 386.5 -> 413.
